title: Brodie Lane South Annexation Focus
summary:
*   A special public hearing was held to discuss the full purpose annexation of the Brodie Lane South area into the city of Austin.
*   The meeting took place at Villie Kocurek Elementary School, providing a local, community-focused venue for public input on the annexation proposal.
*   This focused session addressed a significant city growth policy, aiming to gather discussion on expanding Austin's jurisdiction and services into the designated neighborhood.
